title: Who should see it?
instruction: The principle of least privilege: each post only for those who should see it. Where do these belong?

items.text: A photo from a birthday party at home
items.why: A private moment for the people who were there.

items.text: A video of your club’s performance with only you in it
items.why: There is nothing private in it, and you are proud of it.

items.text: A photo of a concert ticket with a QR code
items.why: Whoever photographs the code can go instead of you.

items.text: A selfie with the name on the doorbell visible behind you
items.why: It gives away where you live.

items.text: A drawing you want to show off
A funny video with a friend who said: only for our group
items.why: His consent covers only your group.

debrief: The wider the circle, the less control. And anything with an address, a code or someone else’s privacy in it doesn’t belong out there at all.
